text: {"score":3,"justification":"Core numbers match the card: 20.7% vs 3.7% expected, score 6.63, z 3.06, 39% low-complexity, 30 documented, 3 of 7 below billed (43%), 5 of 21 with no lab. Language is mostly cautious and next steps are concrete. But the dollar overpayment figures ($1,068, CI $344–$1,791) have no source in the evidence packet, so they cannot be verified and could mislead. The cited examples are weakly matched: C0081673 is cited though its documentation supports 99215 (high MDM), and C0081694 has no documentation in the packet. The summary also does not say that 4 of the 7 documented 99215s supported the billed level, and it omits documented-only context. The rationale repeats itself (99215 share stated twice) and includes boilerplate like 'summary rule flagged'. The headline 'peer 0%' is supported by the card.
